import json; from pathlib import Path; b=json.loads(Path("package/block-summary.json").read_text());
assert b["record_counts"]["cli_captures"]==201
assert b["record_counts"]["native_observers"]==40
assert b["record_counts"]["markers"]==83
assert b["record_counts"]["native_status_queries"]==16
assert b["record_counts"]["notification_waits"]==14
expected={"B1":(5,4),"A1":(3,3),"A2":(4,4),"B2":(4,3)}
for s in b["samples"]:
 name=s["sample"]
 assert (s["native_status_query_count"],s["notification_wait_count"])==expected[name], (name,s["native_status_query_count"],s["notification_wait_count"])
 assert s["business_acceptance"]=="pass", name
 assert s["original_terminal_state"]["flow_status"]=="completed", name
 assert s["original_terminal_state"]["bridge_phase"]=="committed", name
 assert s["original_terminal_state"]["ledger_state"]=="completed", (name,s["original_terminal_state"])
 assert s["worker_check_reply_passed"], (name,s["worker_check_reply"])
 assert any(a["exit_code"]==0 and a["verdict"]=="pass" for a in s["v1_package_assessments"]), (name,s["v1_package_assessments"])
 assert s["decision_preflights"] and s["decision_preflights"][-1]["status"]=="controller_compatible", (name,s["decision_preflights"])
 assert s["bridge_commits"] and s["bridge_commits"][-1]["phase"]=="committed", (name,s["bridge_commits"])
 assert s["package_checkpoint_queries"] and s["package_checkpoint_queries"][-1]["status"]=="completed", (name,s["package_checkpoint_queries"])
assert next(s for s in b["samples"] if s["sample"]=="B2")["coordinator_stage_spans"][-1]["status"]=="duplicate_end_unverified"
assert next(s for s in b["samples"] if s["sample"]=="A2")["coordinator_stage_spans"][1]["status"]=="missing_begin_unverified"
cli=json.loads(Path("package/cli-index.json").read_text()); native=json.loads(Path("package/native-index.json").read_text()); markers=json.loads(Path("package/marker-index.json").read_text());
assert cli["record_count"]==b["record_counts"]["cli_captures"]
assert native["observer_count"]==b["record_counts"]["native_observers"]
assert markers["marker_count"]==b["record_counts"]["markers"]
print(json.dumps({"audit":"pass","samples":{s["sample"]:{"business":s["business_acceptance"],"terminal":s["original_terminal_state"],"worker_check":s["worker_check_reply"],"assessments":s["v1_package_assessments"],"decision_preflight":s["decision_preflights"],"queries":s["native_status_query_count"],"waits":s["notification_wait_count"]} for s in b["samples"]},"cli_records":cli["record_count"],"native_observers":native["observer_count"],"markers":markers["marker_count"]},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
